notes.title: NEW GAME!!! Wishfarers
notes.notes: [p]We're very excited to announce our next game—[b]Wishfarers[/b]![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3942750/Wishfarers/"][/dynamiclink][b]Wishfarers is a turn-based, tactical RPG with streamlined platformer movement, explosive combat, and destructible terrain. [/b][/p][p align="start"]Wishing season is finally here, and the wishfarers are ready to get granting!  Join a plucky band of adventurers as they chase shooting stars, face mysterious foes, fulfill wishes both big and silly, and find a decent pair of socks.[/p][p][/p][p]Wishfarers takes place in the same world as [b]A Book of Beasts and Buddies[/b] and nearly all of the buddies are included. Scoots.. Sasquatches.. Mageshrooms.. even the Garden Dragon! Please check it out and wishlist the game if you're interested![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="2yzDb-pRIFw;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Our new game ‘Kaichu’ is out now!
notes.notes:
Announcing the release of our new game…
[b]Kaichu - The Kaiju Dating Sim[/b]

[previewyoutube=8kLvoXYXxTk;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]KAIJU ROMANCE[/b]
Kaichu is a dating sim about kaiju! You play the role of Gigachu, a gigantic romantic looking for love. Meet six other eligible kaiju and visit twenty-four famous landmarks where Gigachu will answer challenging compatibility questions to decide the fate of your relationship.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1848590/Kaichu__The_Kaiju_Dating_Sim/

If you like visual novels like A Book of Beasts and Buddies, you’ll love Kaichu.
